items.title: Sibling relationships and polite terms
items.pattern: 兄/姉/弟/妹 versus polite reference words
items.explanation: Own-family and someone else's/familiar reference terms vary by context. Learn お兄さん/お姉さん as whole words; do not infer a family relationship from a photograph or person phrase.

items.title: The liked thing with が
items.pattern: person は thing が 好きです
items.explanation: 好き is a な-adjective despite its final kana き. The basic model marks the liked item with が; 好きな本 uses な before the noun.

items.title: A skill area with が
items.pattern: 絵 が 上手/下手 です
items.explanation: The activity/area takes が in the supplied model. 上手 and 下手 describe skill, while 好き and 嫌い describe preference; none substitutes for a productive ability construction.

items.title: Qualitative amount versus exact count
items.pattern: 人が多い / 少ない / たくさんの人 / 少し飲みます
items.explanation: Many/few do not give an exact count. Use the supplied noun-quantity model, avoiding mechanical 多い人 conversion; 少し describes a small amount of the action.
